calendars.title: Calendars & Schedule
calendars.description: Configure the calendar entities and scan interval.

mapping.title: Mode Mapping
mapping.description: Configure day mode display names, default assignments, and event mapping.

schedulers.title: Schedulers
schedulers.description: Assign scheduler switch entities to each day mode.

heat_protection.title: Cover Heat Protection
heat_protection.description: Close covers to their preset position when the temperature rises above a threshold during a configured time window. Uses cover.stop_cover which, on Somfy covers, triggers the 'my' preset (partially-closed position).

data_description.heat_protection_covers: Select the covers to close when the temperature is too high
data_description.heat_protection_sensor: Temperature sensor that triggers the cover closure
data_description.heat_protection_threshold: Temperature above which covers are closed to their preset position
data_description.heat_protection_start: Earliest time of day when heat protection is active
data_description.heat_protection_end: Latest time of day when heat protection is active

sunrise_schedulers.title: Sunrise Scheduler Adjustment
sunrise_schedulers.description: Every morning at 00:15, adjust the opening time of cover schedulers based on the next sunrise. The start time will be max(sunrise, earliest_time).

data_description.sunrise_schedulers: Select the scheduler switches whose start time should follow sunrise
data_description.sunrise_earliest_time: Covers will never open earlier than this time, even when sunrise is earlier

error.invalid_calendar: The specified calendar entity does not exist
